name: TypeScript Compilation Stability
goal: Eliminate all TypeScript compilation errors to establish a stable foundation
success_criteria: npm run build completes without errors
All existing tests continue to pass (180/180)

actions.name: Identify Error Sources
tasks: Categorize errors by type and file
Priority: type mismatches > missing types > strictNullChecks

actions.name: Validate Build
tasks: Run full build: npm run build

actions.name: Regression Test
tasks: Run full test suite: npm test -- --run

risks.risk: Fixing type errors may require refactoring that breaks tests
risks.mitigation: Fix in small increments, run tests after each change
risks.fallback: Revert individual commits if tests fail

risks.risk: Circular dependency issues when adding proper imports
risks.mitigation: Use type-only imports (import type) where possible
risks.fallback: Extract shared types to dedicated files

deliverables: Commit: fix: resolve all TypeScript compilation errors
